mechanism_narrative: The federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) at 0.18% is historically low, and this level is associated with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS is at or below 0.5%, the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL value above 220 signals high inflation, which is associated with negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 220, the 20-day forward returns are negative in less than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 0.5% and the CPI (CPIAUCSL) is above 220, the combination signals a high-inflation, low-rate environment that is associated with negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and CPIAUCSL > 220, the 20-day forward returns are negative in less than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, defined by a quarterly GDP growth rate (GDPC1) above 2%, the S&P 500 is associated with negative returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth rate > 2% in the last quarter
failure_condition: In periods where GDPC1 growth rate > 2% in the last quarter, the 20-day forward returns are negative in less than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5% signals a weak labor market, which is associated with negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 5%, the 20-day forward returns are negative in less than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When employment (PAYEMS) growth exceeds 0.5% and housing starts (HOUST) growth exceeds 0.5% in the last month, the combination signals a strengthening labor and housing market, which is associated with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS growth > 0.5% and HOUST growth > 0.5% in the last month, the 20-day forward returns are positive in less than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 90 signals a weakening economy, which is associated with negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 90, the 60-day forward returns are negative in less than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL value above 220 signals high inflation, which is associated with negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 220, the 5-day forward returns are negative in less than 60% of instances.
